<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>FruitLife 360 Report</title>

  <style>
    @page { size: Letter; margin: 0.62in 0.62in 0.95in 0.62in; }
    @page:first { margin: 0.55in 0.62in 0.85in 0.62in; }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --dydd-green: #4A6239;
      --dydd-sage: #759A5B;
      --dydd-ink: #1f2933;
      --dydd-muted: #647067;
      --dydd-soft: #F6F8F3;
      --dydd-line: #DDE4D5;
      --love: #9E5A4F;
      --joy: #D4A451;
      --peace: #647C9B;
      --patience: #8B7757;
      --kindness: #739D5E;
      --goodness: #4A6239;
      --faithfulness: #5A496B;
      --gentleness: #A9A36F;
      --selfcontrol: #52737A;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--dydd-ink);
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }

    h1 {
      font-size: 31px;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      color: #263322;
      margin: 10px 0 8px;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.18;
      color: #263322;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
    }

    h3 {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      color: #263322;
      margin: 0 0 7px;
    }

    p { margin-bottom: 8px; }

    .footer {
      position: fixed;
      left: 0.62in;
      right: 0.62in;
      bottom: 0.28in;
      display: table;
      width: calc(100% - 1.24in);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      padding-top: 6px;
      color: #6b7280;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .footer-left,
    .footer-right {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .footer-right { text-align: right; }

    .page-break {
      page-break-before: always;
      break-before: page;
    }

    .avoid-break {
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    .muted { color: var(--dydd-muted); }
    .green { color: var(--dydd-green); }
    .small { font-size: 9.5px; }
    .tiny { font-size: 8.5px; }
    .strong { font-weight: 700; }

    .rule {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--dydd-line);
      margin: 12px 0 14px;
    }

    .tier-grid,
    .lens-grid {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 8px 0;
      margin: 10px -8px 14px;
    }

    .tier-card,
    .lens-card {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 33.333%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      padding: 10px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .lens-card { width: 25%; }

    .design-expression-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      table-layout: fixed;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .design-expression-table th,
    .design-expression-table td {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      padding: 4px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .design-expression-table th {
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      color: #263322;
      font-size: 9.8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-align: left;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .design-expression-table th.design-architect {
      background: #D4A451;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .design-expression-table th.design-artisan {
      background: #647C9B;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .design-expression-table th.design-shepherd {
      background: #739D5E;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .design-expression-table th.design-steward {
      background: #5A496B;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .design-expression-table .fruit-cell {
      width: 12%;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .mini-label {
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .formation-card {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      margin: 0 0 11px;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .formation-head {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px 11px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .formation-name,
    .formation-tier {
      display: table-cell;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .formation-name {
      width: 42%;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .formation-tier {
      width: 58%;
      text-align: right;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .formation-body { padding: 10px 11px 11px; }

    .formation-cols {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 10px 0;
      margin: 8px -10px 0;
    }

    .formation-col {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .formation-intro {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 7px 0;
      margin: 8px -7px 11px;
    }

    .formation-tier-box {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 33.333%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      padding: 8px 9px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .formation-tier-box h3 {
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .formation-tier-box p {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 8.7px;
      line-height: 1.28;
    }

    .formation-mini-grid {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 6px 6px;
      margin: 0 -6px;
    }

    .formation-mini-row {
      display: table-row;
    }

    .formation-mini-card {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 33.333%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      background: #ffffff;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .formation-mini-head {
      padding: 6px 8px;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .formation-mini-name {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .tier-strip {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 6px 0;
      margin: 0 -6px 8px;
    }

    .tier-strip-card {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 33.333%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      padding: 6px 8px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .tier-strip-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 3px;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .tier-strip-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 8px;
      line-height: 1.22;
    }

    .formation-rank {
      display: inline-block;
      min-width: 20px;
      margin-right: 6px;
      padding: 2px 5px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 9px;
      line-height: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .formation-mini-tier {
      float: right;
      max-width: 92px;
      text-align: right;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 7.2px;
      line-height: 1.1;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .formation-mini-body {
      padding: 7px 8px 8px;
    }

    .formation-line {
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 8.2px;
      line-height: 1.24;
    }

    .formation-line strong {
      color: #263322;
    }

    .formation-guide-note {
      border-top: 2px solid var(--dydd-line);
      margin-top: 8px;
      padding-top: 8px;
      color: #344235;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .formation-stack {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .logo {
      width: 174px;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    .cover {
      min-height: 8.75in;
      position: relative;
      padding: 2px 0 0;
    }

    .cover-top {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .cover-brand,
    .cover-meta {
      display: table-cell;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .cover-brand { width: 45%; }
    .cover-meta {
      width: 55%;
      text-align: right;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 10px;
      padding-top: 4px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1.6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .cover-grid {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 34px;
    }

    .cover-copy,
    .cover-panel {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .cover-copy { padding-right: 0; }

    .cover-panel {
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .lead {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.58;
      color: #344235;
      margin: 12px 0 18px;
    }

    .cover-copy p {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .scripture {
      border-left: 4px solid var(--dydd-green);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      color: #263322;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .cover-welcome {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      padding: 11px 0 10px;
      margin: 12px 0 4px;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.48;
    }

    .cover-welcome strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .snapshot-panel {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .snapshot-head {
      background: var(--dydd-green);
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 13px 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .snapshot-body { padding: 14px; }

    .metric {
      border-bottom: 1px solid #E9EEE3;
      padding: 9px 0;
    }

    .metric:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .metric-label {
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .metric-value {
      color: #263322;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .metric-note {
      margin-top: 3px;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .cover-bottom {
      display: none;
    }

    .cover-bottom div {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
      vertical-align: top;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9.5px;
    }

    .cover-bottom div:last-child { text-align: right; }

    .cover-panel .snapshot-body {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 8px 0;
      padding: 12px 4px 12px;
    }

    .cover-panel .metric {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 20%;
      border: 0;
      border-left: 1px solid #E9EEE3;
      padding: 0 10px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .cover-panel .metric:first-child { border-left: 0; }

    .cover-panel .metric-value {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .section {
      padding-top: 2px;
    }

    .section-head {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title,
    .section-note {
      display: table-cell;
      vertical-align: bottom;
    }

    .section-title { width: 58%; }
    .section-note {
      width: 42%;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9.5px;
      text-align: right;
    }

    .callout {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-left: 5px solid var(--dydd-green);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 14px;
      background: #ffffff;
      margin: 12px 0;
    }

    .orientation .callout {
      padding: 10px 12px;
      margin: 8px 0;
    }

    .orientation .callout p {
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .callout.soft {
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
    }

    .three-col {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 10px 0;
      margin: 12px -10px 0;
    }

    .three-col .mini-card {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 33.333%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px;
      background: #ffffff;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .mini-label {
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .mini-value {
      color: #263322;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .score-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      table-layout: fixed;
      font-size: 9.5px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .score-table.compact-summary {
      font-size: 10px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .score-table.compact-summary th,
    .score-table.compact-summary td {
      padding: 9px 7px;
    }

    .score-table th,
    .score-table td {
      border: 1px solid #E1E8D9;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      vertical-align: middle;
      word-wrap: break-word;
    }

    .score-table th {
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      color: #2F3A2C;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .score-table td.num,
    .score-table th.num {
      text-align: center;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .fruit-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #263322;
    }

    .score-table td.fruit-cell {
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .score-table td.fruit-cell .fruit-name {
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .score-table.compact-summary .category-pill {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
      background: transparent;
      padding: 0;
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 9.5px;
    }

    .category-pill {
      display: inline-block;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 3px 7px;
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
    }

    .fruit-block {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 10px 0;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    .fruit-head {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .fruit-title,
    .fruit-cat {
      display: table-cell;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .fruit-title {
      width: 45%;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .fruit-cat {
      width: 55%;
      text-align: right;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .fruit-body {
      padding: 12px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .bars {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 8px 0 10px;
    }

    .bar-col {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
      vertical-align: top;
      padding-right: 10px;
    }

    .bar-col:last-child {
      padding-right: 0;
      padding-left: 10px;
    }

    .bar-row {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }

    .bar-label {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .bar-label span {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
    }

    .bar-label span:last-child {
      text-align: right;
      color: #263322;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .bar-track {
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: #EDF2E8;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: var(--dydd-green);
    }

    .bar-fill.observer { background: var(--dydd-sage); }
    .bar-fill.pressure { background: #647C9B; }

    .fruit-love { background: var(--love); }
    .fruit-joy { background: var(--joy); }
    .fruit-peace { background: var(--peace); }
    .fruit-patience { background: var(--patience); }
    .fruit-kindness { background: var(--kindness); }
    .fruit-goodness { background: var(--goodness); }
    .fruit-faithfulness { background: var(--faithfulness); }
    .fruit-gentleness { background: var(--gentleness); }
    .fruit-selfcontrol { background: var(--selfcontrol); }

    .feedback-intro {
      border-left: 7px solid var(--dydd-green);
      background: var(--dydd-soft);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.52;
    }

    .feedback-box {
      border: 1px solid #CAD8BF;
      border-left: 8px solid var(--dydd-green);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 13px 12px 15px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      background: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(74, 98, 57, 0.13);
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    .feedback-page .feedback-box {
      page-break-inside: auto;
      break-inside: auto;
    }

    .feedback-box h3 {
      color: #263322;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #DDE8D4;
      padding-bottom: 7px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      page-break-after: avoid;
      break-after: avoid;
    }

    .quote-text {
      white-space: pre-line;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .next-step {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .next-step-num,
    .next-step-copy {
      display: table-cell;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .next-step-num {
      width: 42px;
      background: var(--dydd-green);
      color: #ffffff;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding-top: 12px;
    }

    .next-step-copy {
      padding: 11px 12px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .next-step-copy strong {
      display: block;
      color: #263322;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .self-plan .next-step {
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .plan-space {
      margin-top: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #CAD8BF;
      background: #FBFCF8;
      min-height: 0.42in;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      font-size: 9px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .scale {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 9px;
    }

    .scale div {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 20%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      padding: 7px 6px;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--dydd-muted);
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .scale strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--dydd-green);
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .snapshot-wide {
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      margin: 12px 0 14px;
    }

    .snapshot-wide .snapshot-body {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 8px 0;
      padding: 10px 4px 10px;
    }

    .snapshot-wide .metric {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 20%;
      border: 0;
      border-left: 1px solid #E9EEE3;
      padding: 0 8px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .snapshot-wide .metric:first-child { border-left: 0; }

    .lens-explain {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin: 8px 0 9px;
      font-size: 8.8px;
    }

    .lens-explain div {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 25%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      padding: 7px;
      vertical-align: top;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .band-grid {
      display: table;
      width: 100%;
      border-spacing: 10px 0;
      margin: 8px -10px 9px;
    }

    .band-card {
      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--dydd-line);
      background: #ffffff;
      padding: 8px 9px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .band-list {
      margin: 5px 0 0;
      padding-left: 15px;
      color: #344235;
      font-size: 9.5px;
    }

    .orientation .snapshot-head {
      padding: 9px 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .orientation .metric-value {
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .orientation .metric-note {
      font-size: 8px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .pattern-grid {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 3px 0 4px;
    }

    .pattern-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 7px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .pattern-card {

    }

      color: #6b7280;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      background: #ffffff;

      display: table-cell;
      width: 50%;
